# AffiLayer

> AffiLayer is a new global CPA affiliate network. Advertisers publish offers
> with a defined payout and conversion action; affiliates promote those offers
> and earn commission on attributed conversions. Tracking is full-funnel with a
> unique click ID per click, and commissions sit in an append-only ledger that
> moves through pending, approved, rejected or reversed states. Payouts are
> manual and admin-approved, Net30 by default. SmartLink is one link that
> routes each visitor to an eligible offer for their country and device using
> clear deterministic rules — no AI optimisation, no guaranteed earnings.
> Operated by MarketSync Global LLC, New Mexico, USA. Contact:
> support@affilayer.com. The network is new and the offer catalogue is small
> while advertisers are onboarded offer by offer. The web app currently runs
> in demo mode while the Supabase backend is being connected.

## Key facts

- Payout models: CPA, CPL, CPS, CPC
- Verticals: Dating, Finance, Gaming, Sweepstakes, Nutra, iGaming
- Payout schedule: manual and admin-approved, Net30 by default
- Tracking link format: /c/{affiliate_code}/{offer_id}, up to five sub-parameters
- Applications reviewed by the team, typically within 2 business days
- No bonus or referral program at launch
- Chat traffic and incentivised traffic are not accepted
